declarations.name: AuiTabs

inputs.name: tabs
inputs.description: Tabs in order. Ids must be unique; they are consumer keys, not DOM ids.

inputs.name: activation
inputs.description: automatic selects on focus; manual needs Enter or Space.

inputs.name: orientation
inputs.description: Layout and arrow keys (Left/Right or Up/Down).

inputs.name: direction
inputs.description: Mirrors Left/Right in rtl. An ancestor dir=rtl also mirrors.

models.name: value
models.description: Selected tab id. Default: the first enabled tab.

outputs.name: changed
outputs.description: The user selected a different tab.

methods.name: panel
methods.description: The tabpanel for a tab id, for consumers to fill.

accessibility.pattern: WAI-ARIA APG Tabs pattern (automatic and manual activation), with native buttons as tabs.

limitations: Panels are always in the DOM (hidden when inactive); lazy content is the consumer's responsibility, for example on aui-change.
Tabs cannot be closed, reordered, or added by the user.
No scroll buttons for an overflowing tablist; it scrolls natively (wheel, touch, keyboard focus).
